EBITDA margin for Q2 FY27 stood at 18.2%, supported by product mix and export growth.

timeline.summary: Bajaj Healthcare received stock exchange listing approvals for 20,79,409 equity shares allotted upon conversion of convertible warrants.
On May 8, 2026, Bajaj Healthcare filed the Monitoring Agency Report for Q4FY26 showing ₹173 crore utilized out of ₹204.97 crore raised.
Bajaj Healthcare reported Q4 FY26 revenue of ₹153.06 Cr and completed warrant conversion raising ₹52.70 Cr.

October 13, 2026: NCLT Mumbai Bench approved Bajaj Healthcare's acquisition of Genrx Pharmaceuticals Private Limited (in Liquidation) on a going-concern basis; Genrx will become a wholly owned subsidiary subject to implementation of the order's terms.
Bajaj Healthcare reported Q2FY27 standalone revenue of ₹175.9 Cr (+18.9% YoY) and PAT of ₹14.1 Cr (+26.9% YoY).
Bajaj Healthcare Limited uploaded the audio recording of its Q2 & H1 FY27 earnings call held on October 19, 2026, signed digitally by Monica Tanwar.
